fulfilled_need_query: Compute the equilibrium lattice constant of diamond-cubic silicon from an equation-of-state fit.
summary: candidate silicon (diamond cubic) (group-IV semiconductor, trust tier)

215d354d-44bf-45c0-9048-1df7726ee532 lattice_constant = 5.467 angstrom via mace-torch 0.3.15 ASE calculator on CUDA GPU, ase.eos.EquationOfState (ase 3.29.0)/MACE-MP-0 medium (universal MLIP trained on PBE/PBE+U MPtrj data), float64 Static 0 K E(V) scan with uniform isotropic strain of ideal diamond-cubic Si (8-atom conventional cell; all atoms on symmetry sites, so forces are zero by symmetry). EOS fit with 3 forms (Birch-Murnaghan, Vinet, Murnaghan), 2 strain windows (+/-3% and +/-6% in a), and 2 point densities (11 and 21 points), 12 fits in total. Value = mean of the 12 fits. Checks: the 64-atom 2x2x2 supercell gives the same BM result as the 8-atom cell (5.46701 vs 5.46701 A); float32 gives 5.46704 A; mean stress at the fitted a is -0.05 GPa. Validation used the same setup on C (diamond), Ge, Cu, Al, Ag.
